test_unique: test the pandas unique method on Index and Series objects to verify order-preserving deduplication
test_unique_null: test the pandas unique method handles np.nan and None values correctly across different dtypes
test_nunique: test the pandas nunique method with dropna=False counts all unique values including duplicates
test_nunique_null: test the pandas nunique method correctly excludes or includes null values depending on dropna parameter
test_nunique_dropna: test the pandas nunique method with dropna=True returns 1 and dropna=False returns 5 for a series with duplicates and nulls
